purpose: Q2 compound-flavour Top-3 for all 50 panel sensory targets, with stability and chemical-rationale grading. Descriptive association, not causal inference.

data_mapping.features: 1.csv non-meta columns (231); 2.csv rows/columns align positionally with that order
data_mapping.targets: 4.csv non-meta columns (50 standardised panel targets, 0 missing)
data_mapping.cross_correlation: 6.csv 44 chemical rows x 50 sensory columns; first 45 columns follow 4.csv target order, last five use explicit synonyms (Alcohol/Carbonation/Aftertaste/Body/Overall appreciation)

2csv_recomputation.positional_order: 2.csv row/column order equals 1.csv non-meta column order
2csv_recomputation.note: The brief names 2.csv Pearson; recomputation shows it is the Spearman matrix of 1.csv under the positional mapping (max abs difference ~1e-16).

data_mapping.spearman_note: The brief labels 2.csv Pearson; recomputation from 1.csv under the positional mapping identifies it as the Spearman matrix. This is disclosed, not silently changed.

candidate_pool.rationale: whole-beer chemistry parameters and derived aggregates are not individual flavour compounds; the same exclusion as the Q2 prototype

model.preprocessing: median impute -> asinh -> standardise X; centre Y

graph.note: networkx Louvain is used instead of the python-louvain package so the community assignment is deterministic under the explicit seed and needs no global state. Louvain tie-breaking depends on node order, so the community count (60) and the largest module (29) are the fixed-seed reproducible values and are asserted in verification.json.

stability.refit_scope: imputation, asinh, scaling, ridge and neighbourhood scores are all recomputed inside each replicate
metrics: bootstrap Top-3 Jaccard vs the full-data Top-3
six pairwise Jaccard values across four ranking methods

evidence_grading: A: identity marker of the dimension, or a direct mechanism class (acid/iron/gas/bitter/...) with bootstrap frequency >=0.5. B: compound mechanism family matches the target sensory family (mechanism argument only). C: exploratory association only, no direct mechanistic support. Confidence: high = A and frequency>=0.5; medium = A/B and frequency>=0.4; low = otherwise.

scope_limits.inference: associational ranking from a 250-beer cross-section; no causal claim, no significance test
scope_limits.validation_status: post-development descriptive analysis on the same 250 historical beers; bootstrap quantifies resampling stability, not sampling or model uncertainty coverage

previous_team_table.interpretation: 17/50 is a GBR-raw-score sub-table, not Q2 coverage; the Ridge sub-table already covers 50/50

scope_limits.sensory_measurement: 4.csv targets are standardised panel means; for diacetyl/DMS/t2n/clove the target-compound Spearman correlation is |rho| <= 0.15, so those dimensions are reported with exploratory (C) entries and are not claimed as identified causes

field_notes.bootstrap_freq: no nan: all 150 Top-3 slots carry a bootstrap frequency
field_notes.off_flavors: nan = the feature dictionary has no off-flavour annotation for this compound; it is not a missing Top-3 slot
field_notes.threshold_mean: nan = no sensory threshold recorded in the feature dictionary for this compound
